# BoostPilot AI

BoostPilot AI is an AI content optimization platform for creators, teams, and brands.

It analyzes images and videos to generate captions, hashtags, hooks, technical quality suggestions, platform-fit scores, and export-ready reports for YouTube, Instagram, Facebook, and LinkedIn.

Public pages:
- https://boostpilotai.vercel.app/
- https://boostpilotai.vercel.app/login
- https://boostpilotai.vercel.app/register
- https://boostpilotai.vercel.app/pricing

Private app areas such as dashboard, analysis history, settings, and admin pages require authentication and should not be indexed.
